skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of psychology used in management.
Analyze individual psychological traits and behaviors.
Understand group dynamics and behavior in organizational settings.
Study the psychological aspects of leadership and its impact on organizations.
Examine customer behavior and preferences from a psychological perspective.
Apply psychological laws to create motivation, manage change, make decisions, and resolve conflicts.
Develop effective communication skills for management roles.
Improve presentation skills for conveying complex ideas.
Learn negotiation techniques for resolving conflicts and managing change.
Master time management strategies for efficient work.
Enhance teamwork skills for collaborative problem-solving.
Develop the ability to work independently and take responsibility for professional tasks.
Understand and apply social responsibility and ethical standards in professional practice.
Foster a continuous learning mindset to adapt to changes in the field.
